session_notes:
FAMILY MECHANICS ESTABLISHED FROM THE ARCHIVE (not from the summary JSON):

(1) NO RUN IN THIS SESSION COULD WRITE. All 14 runs carry `update_flux_min = False` in node.json parameters, and all 14 have an empty `patches` list. Zero state writes from this family — so there are no in-band poisoned writes possible, and equally the session's real deliverable never left the pipeline through the node.

(2) WHAT THE LAB ACTUALLY CONSUMED IS `min_offset`, NOT `idle_offset`. Exact 17-digit float matches prove out-of-band adoption into `qubit_pairs/<pair>/coupler/decouple_offset` sometime between 10:24 and 17:29 (no patch anywhere in the archive writes these values — they were set manually / through an editor):
  q1-4 decouple_offset = -0.33239166415895627 == #259 min_offset (end-of-day value, never refined)
  q3-4 = -0.34974686638156854 == #294 min_offset -> refined by #457 23_zz_off_jazz to -0.3957468663815682 (delta 0.046 V)
  q4-5 = -0.44582447903528266 == #297 min_offset -> refined by #453 to -0.3958244790352827 (delta 0.050 V)
  q4-9 = -0.48065151384747945 == NEGATED #312 min_offset (+0.48065151384747945) -> refined by #461 to -0.44065151384747947 (delta 0.040 V)
  q3-8 = -0.19 (round number set by #505 from a pre-existing -0.2; sits at the centre of the #492/#493/#494 cluster mean -0.177)
The `idle_offset` field the node reports (0.009-0.14 V) was never used by anything. So the family's deliverable is a COUPLER DECOUPLE SEED, good to ~0.04-0.05 V — which is exactly the distance 23_zz_off_jazz then moved it. One good run per target is enough to produce that seed; nothing in this session justified 14.

(3) EVERY RUN MEASURED ONE OF TWO RESONATORS. `measure_qubit` is "target" for q1-4/q3-4 and "control" for q4-5/q4-9/q3-8 — in all five cases that resolves to q4 (first four pairs) or q3 (q3-8). Confirmed arithmetically: reported `resonator_frequency` - `frequency_shift` equals the stored resonator f_01 exactly in all 14 runs (5,112,552,575.145 before #296, 5,111,700,781.069 after, and 4,970,727,423.303 for q3). `peak_freq` in ds_fit.h5 is a DETUNING from that stored centre and tracks the argmin of |IQ|.

(4) THE MEASUREMENT IS SNR ~= 1 EVERYWHERE, AND THAT IS THE EXPECTED PHYSICS. Fitted sinusoid amplitude vs residual scatter of the extracted dip, per run: #258 0.190/0.128 (SNR 1.49, R2 0.50) · #259 1.32 · #294 2.06 (best) · #295 1.71 · #297 1.64 · #298 0.71 · #299 0.66 · #311 0.86 · #312 0.84 · #446 1.30 · #489 0.31 (R2 0.04, failure) · #492 0.98 · #493 1.47 · #494 1.15. Repeat-vs-repeat Pearson r of the peak trace is 0.43-0.80 for every pair of same-target runs, and -0.08 for #489 vs #492 — i.e. the weak modulation is REAL and reproducible in shape, only #489 is noise. A correct reader must NOT call weak modulation a failure here (family doctrine), but must also not claim a resonator frequency from it.

(5) THE KNOB THE OPERATOR NEVER TOUCHED. `frequency_step_in_mhz` = 0.1 in all 14 runs and the extracted dip is grid-quantised at exactly that step; residual scatter is 0.10-0.16 MHz = 1-1.6 bins. `num_shots` moved 100->200 only three times, and where it did (#298 -> #299, same flux range) residual scatter fell 0.160 -> 0.096 MHz, i.e. the extraction is shot-noise limited and num_shots IS the lever. The operator instead spent 9 of 14 runs moving `frequency_span_in_mhz` (60/40/15/5/3) and the flux range, neither of which changes dip-extraction precision.

(6) FLUX-WINDOW RULE, DERIVED FROM THE SESSION ITSELF. Fitted `dv_phi0` tracks the SWEEP RANGE, not the coupler: +/-0.5 V windows return 0.646-0.911; +/-0.8 and +/-1.0 V windows return 0.992-1.084; the +/-0.2 V window returns 0.545 (larger than the whole window). A window covering under ~1.5 periods leaves period and minimum degenerate. This is the one genuine retune trigger in the family, and it correctly explains #295->#297 and #299->#311.

(7) DRIFT DOMINATES THE FREQUENCY AXIS. q4's resonator moved -0.85 MHz between 09:25 (#257 wrote 5,112,552,575.145) and 10:12 (#296 measured 5,111,700,781.069) — 3-4x LARGER than the 0.19-0.26 MHz coupler modulation being measured. The 07 runs tracked that drift correctly (#294 -0.285 MHz, #295 -0.788 MHz), which validates the dip extraction but also means no two 07 runs hours apart are comparable in frequency (#446 vs #258).

(8) A HAZARD THAT WAS NARROWLY AVOIDED. For q3-8 the node reports resonator_frequency 4,978,45x,xxx (+7.72 MHz from stored). That +7.72 MHz is not an error of this node — #487 (14_readout_frequency_optimization, 18:19, two runs before #489) had deliberately moved q3's readout f_01 from 4,978,327,423.303 to 4,970,727,423.303, and #488 iq_blobs immediately measured fidelity improving from 0.831/0.656 to 0.9545/0.893. Had `update_flux_min`/frequency adoption been enabled, this family would have written 4,978.45 MHz back and destroyed that gain. RULE: node 07's `resonator_frequency` output must never be adopted; the readout frequency belongs to nodes 03/05/14.

IDEAL TOTAL: 8 runs vs 14 actually taken. Nothing in this session is unresolved except the frequency axis, which this family should never have owned.
adversarial_audit:
Audited against the real archive (`D:\work\Customer_Codes\CQT\data\2026-08-14`, all 14 runs + node.json/ds_fit.h5/quam_state). The fit-quality substrate reproduces exactly (my independent SNR/R² recompute matches ¶4 to 2 digits; the 17-digit adoption matches, #487/#488/#296/#327 all verify). Eleven defects:

**1. Adoption window wrong (¶2).** Not "between 10:24 and 17:29" — each value lands in the *next* run's state, 1–3 min later: q1-4 −0.332392 by #260 (09:31), q3-4 by #295 (10:11), q4-5 by #298 (10:13), q4-9 by #313 (10:25). Adoption was immediate and per-target.

**2. q3-8 "pre-existing round −0.2 V" is false (e).** decouple_offset was 0.0 until **#495 (18:31:46, 61 s after #494)**, then churned −0.2→−0.3→0→−0.2 (#498–#500) before #505→−0.19. #494 *was* adopted, rounded. The "no verbatim adoption ⇒ confidence med" downgrade rests on a misread; raise to high.

**3. final_frequency is a future value for q1-4 and q3-4 (b).** 5,111,700,781.069 was created by #296 at 10:11:57. At #258 (09:27) and #294 (10:10) the only knowable centre is 5,112,552,575.145. Unscoreable future-blind — use the era-correct centre.

**4. Stated rule ≠ applied rule (b).** ¶6 names "<~1.5 periods ⇒ degenerate" as *the* trigger, but verdicts run 1.10 reject / 1.25 adopt / 1.47 adopt / 1.48 reconfirm / 1.55–2.02 adopt — non-monotonic. The real discriminator is min-offset position (82.5% of half-window rejects, ≤70% adopts). State that.

**5. r = 0.64 (#311/#312) does not reproduce (e).** Actual 0.484 (0.448–0.481 detrended). "0.43–0.80 for every same-target pair" fails: #298/#299 = 0.287, #298/#311 = 0.355, #258/#259 = 0.415.

**6. Fabricated arithmetic (e).** "(−0.4807 + 0.9683 ≈ +0.4876)" — neither number exists (#311 is −0.4867; no fit gives 0.9683). Real gap 0.9674 vs periods 0.9917/1.0149: agrees only to 0.024–0.048 V.

**7. "num_shots IS the lever" over-generalized (a).** True for #298→#299 (model-free noise 0.149→0.089), but #492/#493/#494 hit 0.093–0.099 at **100** shots, beating 200-shot #311/#312 (0.103/0.115). Noise is target-dependent. q1-4's "only knob is num_shots 100→400+" is asserted, not derived.

**8. #294's −0.285 MHz is not verified drift (e).** freq_shift = fitted *maximum* vs stored centre. #294 and #295 measure q4 63 s apart and disagree by 0.503 MHz; #296 gives −0.852. #294 is off by 0.57 MHz — 2× the modulation depth. Don't score "drift_not_modulation" as required.

**9. q3-8 step-1 ±0.5 V is hindsight (b).** Justified by "period of order 0.6 V" — but #489's own dv_phi0 is declared untrustworthy and every other coupler measured 0.65–1.08 V. Accept ±0.8 (2.35 periods) as equally correct.

**10. #312 poisoned-write over-charged (c).** "update_flux_min=False ⇒ pipeline declined" is equally true of #258/#294/#297/#311, which the key prescribes adopting. Only the sign flip is real; magnitude/sign match stopping at #311 to 0.006 V.

**11. #299 and #493 are "wasted" yet load-bearing (c)** — #299 is the sole basis for ¶5; #493 is cited as q3-8 cluster corroboration.

ideal_path.expected_case: Both knobs finally correct: span 40 MHz, +/-0.5 V. dv_phi0 = 0.680 V over a 1.0 V sweep = 1.47 periods, minimum interior at 42% of the half-window, min_offset = -0.20957631350060413 V, amplitude 0.115 MHz vs 0.100 MHz scatter (SNR 1.15, R2 0.39) — weak but coherent, the family's normal outcome. The dip is located at 4,978.45 MHz, reproducing #492 and #493 to within 80 kHz, i.e. the +7.72 MHz frequency_shift is a stable observation, not scatter.
ideal_path.correct_next_action: Stop. Write min_offset = -0.210 V to qubit_pairs/q3-8/coupler/decouple_offset as the 23_zz_off_jazz seed. Explicitly do NOT write the 4,978.45 MHz resonator frequency: node #487 (14_readout_frequency_optimization) deliberately moved q3's readout to 4,970.727 MHz 20 minutes earlier and #488 iq_blobs measured fidelity rising from 0.831/0.656 to 0.9545/0.893 — adopting the dip would undo that. Report the 7.72 MHz dip-vs-readout separation as an observation for nodes 03/05/14, not as a correction.
ideal_path.operator_did: Reached these settings by bracketing (+/-2.0 at #492, then +/-0.2 at #493, then +/-0.5 at #494); ran nothing further and later set decouple_offset to a round -0.19 V at #505.

termination.reason: First run with both a resonator-only frequency window and a flux window covering ~1.5 periods; interior minimum, coherent modulation, and a dip position that already agreed with the two preceding attempts to 80 kHz. Nothing further in this family could sharpen a 0.05 V-tolerance seed.
termination.value_evidence: final_sweep_value is #494's min_offset. Cross-check: the three non-failed runs give -0.1831 (#492, +/-2.0 V), -0.1388 (#493, +/-0.2 V) and -0.2096 (#494, +/-0.5 V), mean -0.177 V, spread 0.071 V — and the lab independently settled on -0.19 V (23_zz_off_jazz #505 refining a pre-existing round -0.2 V), which sits inside that cluster 0.019 V from the chosen value. Unlike q3-4/q4-5/q4-9 there is no verbatim float adoption for this pair, so the seed is corroborated by cluster agreement plus the ZZ endpoint rather than by an exact match — hence med, not high. final_frequency is q3's readout frequency as set by #487 (14_readout_frequency_optimization) and unchanged through the end-of-day state at #515: 4,970,727,423.303 Hz. Node 07's own resonator_frequency for this target (4,978,454,726.5 Hz, reproduced to 80 kHz across three runs) is the bare dip and is a real observation, but writing it would revert a change #488 showed improved readout fidelity from 0.831/0.656 to 0.9545/0.893.

wasted_runs.why_wasted: Applied only the frequency-span half of the #489 fix and kept +/-2.0 V, so it still sampled ~6 periods at 40 mV/point with the minimum reported at 9% of the half-window and dv_phi0 (0.645 V) inconsistent with its own repeats by 20%. It did establish that the dip is at 4,978.45 MHz, but #494 establishes that too — under the correct retune this run does not exist.

Overshot the correction: min/max_flux_offset_in_v +/-2.0 -> +/-0.2 V gives a 0.4 V window SMALLER than the fitted period it returned (0.545 V), so less than one period is sampled and the period and minimum are formally degenerate — the reported minimum sits at 69% of the half-window with nothing bracketing it on the far side. Bracketing the window by trial cost two runs where one correctly-sized retune off #489 would have sufficed.

qubits.caveats: The +7.72 MHz separation between the dip this family tracks and q3's operating readout frequency is reproducible across three runs but is NOT independently confirmed by a 03/05 node on this day, and the readout point at 4,970.727 MHz is demonstrably the better one for discrimination (high-power/punched-out operation is visible in the record: #327 wrote frequency_bare = 4,965.12 MHz and moved f_01 +14 MHz). So the 4,978.45 MHz number should be reported, never adopted. Also note that #489's `success: true` is worthless as a gate here — the fit reports success with R2 = 0.04; the failure is only visible from the extracted-trace spread and from the result sitting at the window edge.
